royal_trouble: Throne of Miscellania completion opens the quest; skill levels do not gate the Ghrim conversation.
40 Agility and 40 Slayer are boostable gates within the cave and boss, respectively.
Five coal, ropes and plank are needed for the dungeon rig, but most temporary parts and plank/rope are provided there.
The actual Sigrid reward of 20,000 coins is awarded before the final Vargas 1-QP / 5,000 Agility, Slayer and Hitpoints XP package.
cold_war: Build-242 Quest Helper declares unboosted 10 Hunter, 30 Agility, 30 Crafting, 34 Construction, and 15 Thieving for start.
Requires ten oak planks and ten steel nails, held spade and hammer, steel bar, plank and silk for the clockwork suit, raw cod or an activated Ring of Charos, and music materials.
Access to a player-owned house crafting table 3 or better is independently required; conditional access stage models using one's own or another player's table.
Penguin greeting emotes, KGP checkpoint identification, underwater agility obstacles and Icelord encounter are staged separately.

observations.royal_trouble: Advisor Ghrim, the previously chosen spouse, Vargas, Gunnhild, Sigrid, Matilda and the missing sailor precede dungeon permission. The cave includes Donal, a propped crevice, coal-engine pulley repair, plank/rope agility obstacles, diary pages and an instanced Giant Sea Snake. Royal peace ends with Sigrid's letter and payment, then Vargas's final reward. Enhanced kingdom management and 80 Sailing Bosun Zarah eligibility are flags, not immediate sailing training.
observations.cold_war: The first Larry expedition uses a 10-oak-plank hide on the Iceberg. The player crafts a penguin suit using a clockmaker table, visits Ardougne penguins, follows Larry to Lumbridge sheep and a dairy cow for a cowbell, and returns to the Iceberg's KGP base. Noodle ID, avalanche entry, agility obstacles, Ping/Pong and the war-room Icelord guard lead to Larry's completion conversation. One Icelord awards 40 Attack XP separately from the fixed completion rewards.
observations.travel: Royal Trouble links existing Miscellania/Etceteria castle waypoints to the dungeon and its one-way post-boss exit. Cold War connects existing Ardougne Zoo, Rellekka, Lumbridge/Fred and Rimmington house portal hubs to newly observed Iceberg and underground waypoints; first zoo-to-Iceberg teleport requires construction supplies. All timings remain estimates.
observations.supplies: Trade-enabled budgets: 9,000 coins for five coal and a twelve-lobster combat reserve in Royal Trouble; 16,000 for Cold War materials. Cold War raw cod is consumed by the selected penguin persuasion branch. Quest item transformations and exact prices have not been independently verified.
observations.rewards: Royal Trouble: 1 QP, 20,000 coins at Sigrid, 5,000 XP each Agility/Slayer/Hitpoints at Vargas, improved kingdom and Sailing-dependent Bosun Zarah/Etceteria access. Cold War: 1 QP, 2,000 Crafting XP, 5,000 Agility XP, 1,500 Construction XP, and 40 Attack XP for one required Icelord; penguin suit and course unlock.
